notes: Decimals are strings. price is the one share price every route uses (sharePriceOf in apps/api). Null means no real data yet, never zero.
high24h, low24h and volume24h come only from real fills on the DEX (trades) and price ticks; no fill means null.
revenue24h, paidPerShare24h and paidToHoldersLastNight come from the dividend ledger, the same source as Home, Market yield and Portfolio.
change24hPct is measured from openPrice, today's first price (00:00 UTC).
bids and asks are the live share/USDC offers on the XRPL DEX (book_offers). trades are fills with ledger links. Refreshes on the market SSE event.
